title: Brianstorm
lyrics:
[00:37.82]Brian, top marks for not tryin'
[00:42.48]So kind of you to bless us
[00:44.33]With your effortlessness
[00:45.73]We're grateful and so strangely comforted
[00:49.17]And I wonder
[00:51.41]Are you putting us under?
[00:54.96]'Cause we can't take our eyes
[00:56.51]Off the t-shirt and ties combination
[00:59.55]Well, see you later, innovator
[01:11.52]Some want to kiss, some want to kick you
[01:14.36]There's not a net you couldn't slip through
[01:17.55]Or at least that's the impression I get
[01:19.64]'Cause you're smooth and you're wet
[01:21.10]And she's not aware yet, but she's yours
[01:23.63]She'll be saying, "Use me
[01:26.41]Show me the jacuzzi"
[01:29.31]I imagine that it's there on a plate
[01:31.39]Your high rendezvous rate
[01:32.82]Means that you'll never be frightened to make 'em wait for a while
[01:36.67]I doubt it's your style
[01:39.12]Not to get what you set
[01:41.78]Out to acquire, the eyes are on fire
[01:44.44]You are the unforecasted storm
[02:11.16]Calm, collected and commanding
[02:14.01]You leave the other stories standing
[02:16.23]With your renditions and jokes
[02:17.73]Bet there's hundreds of blokes
[02:19.32]That have wept 'cause you've stolen their
[02:22.51]Thunder
[02:24.40]Are you putting us under?
[02:27.94]'Cause we can't take our eyes
[02:29.49]Off the t-shirt and ties combination
[02:32.56]Well, see you later, innovator
